reviews.text:
I had a great experience with CaliK9 dog training ! They were patient, knowledgeable, and really took the time to understand our dog and what we needed help with.

The training made a noticeable difference in our dog’s behavior, and we learned a lot about how to communicate with and work with our dog at home. We really appreciated the professionalism, patience, and personalized approach throughout the process.

I would highly recommend CaliK9 to anyone looking for a reliable and caring dog trainer. We’re very happy with the results and grateful for all the help!

I am editing this review because I left out some important information:
- the part about how I came to connect with CALIK9…

My son, who happens to be a certified dog trainer (but doesn’t train dogs for a living), was at the skate park every Saturday and would watch Devin train a bunch of working breeds. When I started looking for a trainer, he told me about the dogs at this park and how Devin could have them on commands right on the edge of the skate park. He sent me videos of the action. I sat on this information while I looked for other trainers closer to my home. Meanwhile my son approached Devin for his contact information. I checked out the website, the YouTube videos…and took the bait! And I’m so glad I did!

I started working with Devin when my mixed large breed dog (Malinois, German Shepherd, Staffy, Pit, and Mastiff!) hit 16 months old; the "teenage" high intensity was becoming scary and sometimes unmanageable. She is incredibly high-drive and strong, and I was struggling to find a balance between managing her energy and getting consistent focus.

Just three weeks of sessions with Devin….I now have much more confidence to continue effective communication with my dog using the right tools and methods! In class, and out of class instruction (through training videos) provides so much help! If you have a powerful, high-energy dog, look no further! CALIK9 understands exactly how a large, high-intensity breed thinks and tailors the instructions to what my dog actually needs. But there are also lots of little pups in class too! So whatever size dog you have, you can’t go wrong with CALIK9’s training help!

Lastly, I really appreciate the consistent and thorough communication from my very first contact with Jas and Madison!
Smart, patient, caring training. 10/10 recommend.

I have 2 dogs that have been in training with CaliK9 trainer Devin for the last 2.5 months.  We still have a lot of work to go, but the tools and guidance we have been provided have shown day and night difference in some of the things I was struggling with.  My dogs are showing more engagement and focus, and our walks have gotten so much easier.  The approach is firm but still kind and fair to the dog. My dogs are middle aged, stubborn working breeds so they have some long standing bad habits that’s going to take work to unlearn.  Devin has been a great help and knowledgeable source for us. 10/10 very happy with my decision to sign up for training with CaliK9
Still amidst the process but amazing progress so far - can see their methods start working after only the first session!

My husband and I have owned dogs and helped dog-sit for 16 years. Our dogs have always been very well trained, so we thought we knew a lot—but our new pup definitely challenged us! That’s when we realized we needed some extra support, and we’re so glad we found it.

We’ve been working with Cali K9 for four months now, and they’ve helped us tremendously with our pup. Devin, their senior trainer, has been an incredible teacher and support. We’ve learned so much, and our pup is making great progress.

We especially appreciated how they started us off gradually with Zoom and private classes before introducing group classes. It made the transition smooth and effective.

It’s absolutely worth the investment—this is a lifelong investment in both our dog and our relationship with them. We’re so happy to have gained the knowledge we needed.

We are so grateful to Cali K9 for the huge difference they’ve made in our life. We were feeling hopeless and devastated as our dog, Milo, was beginning to show aggressive and concerning behaviors. We reached out to Cali K9 and although we were still skeptical, we decided to give it a chance. Within weeks Milo started to show progress and now he has accomplished things we didn’t think he could. We are especially grateful to our trainer, Devin, who has taught us so much. Not only is he incredibly knowledgeable but he is very empathetic to each dog’s individual needs. We cannot thank Devin enough for the difference he’s made with our pup. Not only are Milo’s behaviors improved, but we now feel empowered and confident. Thank you Devin and Cali K9.

I'll be signing  up again  as a returning  client.  Thank you guys  for all the experience  you bring when it comes  to training  all types  of breeds.

I'm in the LA Cali K9 and Devin our trainer is legit! I'm seeing a world of difference in my Boy Georgie! He is slightly reactive but since the training, it's gone down majorly and he's listening and becoming less insecure. When friends visit now, they are always like, "woah, he's so calm now" and he's only 2 years old. Yay!

I brought my service dog to Cali K9 because I wanted real structure and reliability, not just basic obedience. What stood out immediately was the professionalism and clarity in their training system. Everything is structured, consistent, and explained in a way that makes sense for both the dog and the owner.

Madison, the Operations Manager, was excellent from the start. She responded to every email promptly and made the entire process smooth and organized. That level of communication sets the tone for the whole experience.

Devin was our senior trainer, and what impressed me most is that he didn’t just train the dog — he trained me and my wife. He broke down the timing, structure, and expectations in a clear way so we could maintain the standard ourselves. That accountability makes a big difference, especially with a service dog.

You can tell Jas has built a complete and professional team. The standards are consistent, and everyone operates with clarity and purpose.

Since training, my dog is more focused, more stable in public, and much clearer mentally. We’ve taken him to restaurants, traveled, and worked around high-distraction environments. He settles on his own, holds position, and understands expectations. The biggest improvement has been in his impulse control and engagement.

If you’re looking for structure, clarity, and real results instead of temporary fixes, Cali K9 delivers.

I’ve been with Cali K9 for about a year, and the results have been incredible. I learned how to properly communicate with my dog, and now we can walk calmly without pulling or reacting to other dogs. Before Cali K9, he was extremely dog-reactive and would bark and lunge at every dog he saw. I’m so grateful for the progress we’ve made.

Madison has been so kind and helpful throughout the scheduling process. Devin has been the highlight of our experience ..he’s really great and informative with my Luna and has such a calm, confident way of working with her. We’re grateful for his support and guidance.

The Cali K9 board and train program is phenomenal. While we’ve had other dogs previously. This is the first time we’ve had a Doberman. We tried an alternate training program and noticed she would benefit from a more comprehensive and professional experience. We chose to make this investment with Cali K9 and couldn’t be happier.

While it was the first time we’ve gone through a board and train program and the time away was a challenge. Cali K9 and their team made the preparation and planning easy. Everyone took the time to make sure we didn’t have any questions or hesitation. You can tell they truly care and are passionate about what they do. They take the time to learn about you, your pup, the relationship between you both, your goals and challenges.

We looked towards the weekly updates to see our pups progress. While we missed her we knew she was happy and being cared for through the videos and taking on all the benefits of the program through the trainers updates that were shared with the weekly phone call.

Thank you to Madison, Drew, Devon, and Candace for taking such great care of our pup.

The board and train phase has been an incredible foundation and kickstart into the rest of the Cali K9 program.

We sent our Rottie, Gemma, to Cali K9 North for their 4-week board and train program, and she was transported safely to their North Hollywood location. The entire experience was wonderful from start to finish.

Before training, Gemma was skittish and somewhat reactive, which made walks a challenge. During her stay, she even went into heat, but the team was incredibly understanding and accommodating, allowing her to continue training comfortably and successfully.

After working with Candace and Devin, Gemma is a calmer dog, more confident, and attentive. Her walks are smooth and enjoyable, she follows commands beautifully, and she is a much happier dog overall -- and so are we!

A special thank-you to Drew for the weekly updates and videos -- we looked forward to them every time and loved seeing her progress. We also want to thank Madison for answering all our questions and calming any doubts we had before and after signing her up.

We're so grateful to Candace, Devin, Drew, Madison, and the entire Cali K9 North Hollywood team for their care, professionalism, and dedication. The results truly speak for themselves!

This has nothing to do with his training at all. I’m sure he’s great trainer. However, for my phone evaluation he was nearly an hour late and he seemed to be very distracted by his environment, loud with barking dogs. No hard feelings just wish we would have rescheduled for a better time.

Edit: his responses to negative reviews says a lot.

I'd like to send a shout out as the online Outdoor Challenge program is helping Athena with impulse control. I was so happy this morning. I opened up the garage door and didn't notice the cat laying in the yard, but Athena did. She stopped beside me and looked up at me,  I didn't know what she was trying to tell me until I did a scan of the front yard and saw the cat. Oh, and she is no longer bothered by the noise the trash bin makes when I walk it up and down the driveway.

I do need to work on her sit before we go out side or she will turned me in circles and make me sick. I am the one recovering from a brain injury and Jas gave me encouragement and said that I just need to take it slow and it will be done. Bless him!!!

Cali K9 has been a life saver for my reactive 2 year old, 130+ Anatolian Shepherd mix Milo! After just 1 week with Hamza, Milo’s behavior changed dramatically. This once nervous, growly, snappy dog has become a cuddly, confident, happy pup. From Jas’ direction and encouragement, to Madison’s scheduling accommodations, Devin’s online classes, & Hamza’s true caring and expertise - I couldn’t recommend enough the value of this group, especially for reactive dogs. While Milo still has a ways to go, the leaps and bounds progress that he has made so far is encouraging for his and our family’s future.

Just got our 2 girl-Pits back from Board and Train, and are already impressed with their transformation!

We’ve struggled for years with leash and territorial aggression, which kept us from being able to travel as a family, and generally feeling lost and unable to support our dogs through their big feelings

Enter Cali K9.

The team is highly invested in your successful adoption of the Cali K9 method. Not only do they provide the tips/tricks and tools necessary to establish yourself as a pack leader and handler, but they genuinely show they care with their attentiveness.

After initial consultations with Jas, Madison took the lead in explaining the process to come. During their stay, she and Drew were responsive, great listeners, understanding and forthcoming with information. Excellent follow-through with videos and check-ins throughout and post-B&T.

They sought our perspective and graciously accepted constructive feedback on how to make the program even better

We’re now in the capable hands of Hamza, who is providing US the training we need to
effectively communicate to our girls. There is more work to be done, and we are excited to keep going. We are so happy with the kick start from Board and Train.

Happy to be a part of the Cali K9 Family!!! 🐕‍🦺🦮

Cali K9 in-person training has been wonderful for my large breed puppy. Our trainer, Devin, is great with the dogs and very patient with the humans as we learn how to effectively communicate with our pets. My puppy loves training; he thinks it's a fun game! He knows many commands, and although we still have some work to do (he's only nine months old), he's already remarkably well-behaved.

I had my 1 year old golden retriever board and trained from December 2024 to January 2025 and during those 4 weeks of training they only thought 4 commands: sit, place, heel, chase. Heel wasn’t fully trained, chase command doesn’t make sense since we don’t use it in every day life.
While I think they are great dog trainers, I find board and training was waste of $4800. First evening after picking my dog up, I noticed that Walk on leash was the same as before the training. No changes at all. He still was Reactive to skates (which I mentioned to trainer and in the application) was not addressed. He still pulled the Leash, he still got excited and jumping when people approached him. And that was the first walk after the 4 weeks board and training. Trainings were mostly done indoors, i never got any videos of outdoor real life trainings.
Overall, I regret spending almost 5k, I didn’t get what I saw on instagram videos and advertisements.
During 4 weeks, I got like 3-4 short videos.
I called Calikk9 week after, asking Madison, that I need the owner to evaluate my dog and see if he’s happy with the training, she assured that with my board and train I get some online and in person classes hopping problems will be fixed. Attended on first online class, was the same 4 commands for beginners. Called again, she put me on intermediate classes however 3 classes were canceled in a row. Trainer sick, trainer on vacation etc…After that I wasn’t even scheduled for any classes. I think my honest review will help people save 5k on board and training and do in-person classes instead
